scheme_name: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Punjab.
The applicant must be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker).
The applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000 or below.
The applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
The applicant must not be a member of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), National Pension System (NPS), or Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).
The applicant must not be an income tax payer.
The applicant must be a child of a registered construction worker under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab.
The applicant must have acquired skill training from technical institutions such as ITIs or Polytechnic colleges.
benefits_summary: Full course fee and hostel boarding/lodging assistance for children of registered workers.
